headings.usage: Use for all H1-H6. Tracking tight (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, inputs, and UI text.

code.usage: Use for data values, API keys, and code snippets.

buttons.secondary: bg-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-all duration-300

inputs.default: bg-gray-950/50 border border-gray-800 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-gray-600 transition-all

effects: Use 'bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-400 to-cyan-400' for key headings.

general: Implement the 'Elion' brand as a high-end, futuristic AI tool.
Use the 'Control Room' grid strategy for the dashboard: dense data, high contrast.
Ensure all text is legible against the dark background (use gray-300/400 for secondary text, white for primary).
Use the provided image URLs for their respective sections. Do not use placeholders.
For the 'Brain' visualization, use a central glowing node effect using CSS shadows or a simple SVG.

pages.landing: Use the 'Tetris' grid. Hero section must be immersive with the neural background.
pages.dashboard: Sidebar navigation. Main area uses glass cards for widgets.
pages.connections: Grid of cards for integrations. Use the logos provided.
pages.brain: Central visualization of the AI decision process. Use pulsing animations.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
